note: Wins over public/pairs.json. none hides every product for that slug (pins included). block drops those product ids. pin inserts those ids first, still capped at 3. promote: true, or promote: [product ids], lifts probation for that slug (full chip, not the muted one). Probation is pairs-gen's flag on a newly added auto id. It also lifts when public/pair-signals.json has min real pair_click counts for that slug and product. defaults.category.Bot Tools is none unless that slug sets none to false (keep the curated rows) or lists pin. A new bot with no curated row and no override shows nothing. Edit pairs.json for a scored reason; do not match on category. Curated rows (no auto flag) are never rewritten by pairs-gen.

ops-bot.reason: Patches bot packages and connectors. A drill is not relevant.

archivist.reason: Writes standing rules into other bots. No physical gear.

twain.reason: Literary voice of Mark Twain, not a microphone.

sushi-and-ramen.reason: Finds sushi and ramen nearby. Not a pressure cooker.
